content_blocks.title: Practice reasoning
content_blocks.text: This temporary-file example demonstrates a local save/load round trip. Only load artifacts you trust; serialization formats based on pickle can execute code during loading. For safer and interoperable model formats, keep the problem definition, data selection, estimator configuration, and evaluation criterion explicit. When results are uncertain, compare a baseline and inspect examples rather than treating one metric as a complete explanation.

content_blocks.code:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import joblib
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
model = LinearRegression().fit([[1], [2], [3]], [2, 4, 6])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 path = Path(d) / "trusted-model.joblib"
 joblib.dump(model, path)
 restored = joblib.load(path)
 print(restored.predict([[4]]).round(1).tolist())

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: Check input shapes, target alignment, data types, missing values, label order, and whether the expected output assumes a fixed random seed.
